o.text: Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *kūr-ïk, *kūr-ïgak (“dry”). Cognate with Chuvash хӑрӑк (hărăk).
Borrowed from Classical Persian آزادی (āzādī). By surface analysis, azad + -i.
